sources.title: Retrospective of the ARPA-E ALPHA fusion program
sources.summary: This paper provides a retrospective of the ALPHA (Accelerating Low-cost Plasma Heating and Assembly) fusion program of the Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy (ARPA-E) of the U.S. Department of Energy. sources.title: Large Synoptic Survey Telescope: Dark Energy Science Collaboration
sources.summary: This white paper describes the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration (DESC), whose goal is the study of dark energy and related topics in fundamental physics with data from the Large Synoptic Survey Telescope (LSST). sources.summary: Robot vision has greatly benefited from advancements in multimodal fusion techniques and vision-language models (VLMs). sources.title: Metal Alloys for Fusion‐Based Additive Manufacturing
sources.summary: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) is an innovative manufacturing technique, which builds parts incrementally layer by layer. Thus, metal AM has inherent advantages in part complexity, time, and waste saving. However, due to its complex thermal cycle and rapid solidification during processing, the alloys well suit and commercially used for metal AM today are limited.
